setting.polylog.pageSize.description: Commits fetched per repository per page.
setting.polylog.maxConcurrency.descripti: Maximum number of git processes running at once.
setting.polylog.scanDepth.markdownDescri: Folder levels to search the workspace folders for repositories. Polylog shows these together with the repositories the Git extension has open. See also `#git.repositoryScanMaxDepth#`.
setting.polylog.excludeRepos.description: Glob patterns for repositories to leave out, matched against the repository folder name and its full path.
setting.polylog.profiles.markdownDescrip: Named groups of repositories for the Repo List, e.g. `{ "backend": ["acme-api", "acme-libs"] }`. Each repository is its path relative to the workspace folder (`.` for the folder itself; in a multi-root workspace, the folder's name first). Saved from the Repo List; clicking a profile ticks its repositories and changes no other filter.
setting.polylog.blame.markdownDescriptio: Show who last changed the cursor's line in Polylog's diffs and revisions, as of the commit shown. The text follows `#git.blame.editorDecoration.template#`.
